name: Graužikai - Kelmė Race
description: The “Graužikai–Kelmė” V. Rimkus Memorial Run took place on October 28, 2023, in Kelmė, marking the 50th anniversary of this traditional event. This year, more than 200 runners from across Lithuania and guests from Ukraine took part. Vitalij Kuznetsov was the fastest in the 8 km race. The fastest woman was Aurika Balsytė, who is from Kelmė District. There was also a 1.8 km race, in which Lukas Mikavičius performed best, and a 200 m race for young children.

name: Pagarbos bėgimas IN MEMORIAM
location: Vingio parko estrada, M. K. Čiurlionio gatvė, Vilnius
description: On October 19 at 10:00, the 10th annual “In Memoriam” tribute and charity run will take place in Vingis Park, Vilnius, honoring those who sacrificed their lives for our freedom. The event brings together a community committed to remembering and commemorating these heroes. Participants in the 10 km race will compete for awards in the Open Lithuanian Armed Forces Championship. There will also be non-competitive 1 km and 4 km options to run, walk or roll; no winners or prize-winners will be selected.

name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: The Backyard Ultra World Championship is a unique off-road running event where runners must complete a 6.7 km loop every hour until only one runner remains. The race takes place on hilly, off-road courses that demand endurance and determination. It tests both physical and mental stamina, and there is always only one winner. Trailo Kalvė organizes the event with special attention to course quality and the participant experience, inviting runners to test themselves and push their limits.
course_highlights: Off-road courses through hilly terrain
A 6.7 km loop every hour
The race continues until only one runner remains
additional: The race takes place during the cold season, most often on Sundays. Participants receive a Trailo Kalvė running headband when they register for the first time that season. Medals are awarded only for exceptional achievements, not at every stage. Around 15 athletes will take part in the event; courses range from 5 km to 60 km; free training sessions are offered; medals and souvenirs are given away; the event aims to break records for completing 100 miles in 24 hours; it has been organized since 2022.

name: XII Pagarbos/Paramos bėgimas „IN MEMORIAM“, skirtas šiais metais mirusiems kariams atminti
organizer: Lietuvos didžiosios kunigaikštienės Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų organizacija
price_range: bilieto kaina – Jūsų pasirinkta paramos suma
description: The “In Memoriam” Run of Remembrance and Support in Vilnius is a significant event dedicated to honoring Lithuanian Armed Forces service members who died this year and supporting their families. Held in Vingis Park, it features non-competitive 1 km and 4 km distances, as well as the open 10 km Lithuanian Armed Forces Running Championship. The run began as a heartfelt initiative to remember a young officer and has become an important annual civic and patriotic tradition. It is organized by the LDK Birutė Association of Women from Officers’ Families together with the Ministry of National Defence and the Lithuanian Armed Forces.
course_highlights: Courses in Vingis Park, Vilnius
Non-competitive 1 km and 4 km distances
Open 10 km Lithuanian Armed Forces Running Championship
additional: The event is patronized by the Commander of the Lithuanian Armed Forces, General Raimundas Vaikšnoras. Participants can run, walk, or roll the 1 km and 4 km distances; there is no competition, and no winners or prizewinners are selected for these distances. The event also includes a 10 km race with competitive elements. Support for the families of deceased service members is collected via Paysera, a bank account, and PayPal. The event honors the service members, and donated funds go to their families; it takes place in autumn.

name: Trail Kursiu Nerija #TKN
description: Trail Kuršių Nerija #TKN is a wonderful trail run in the Curonian Spit, Lithuania, offering a range of distances from a 1 km children’s course to an extreme 104 km. The event delights participants with its unique views, sandy trails, and the option to run or walk at their own pace. It’s a great opportunity to experience the beauty of nature and spend active time with family or friends. The event welcomes all running abilities and age groups.
course_highlights: Nature trails with plenty of sand
Distances ranging from 1 km for children to 104 km for extreme runners
Invaluable views of the Curonian Spit
additional: The 10 km course has 76 m of elevation gain and is limited to 400 participants. The children’s 1 km course is limited to 200 participants and includes a run with an entertainer in a heated tent. Participants in the 10 km course must bring an ID document and a charged mobile phone or watch with the course GPX file. After the finish, participants are offered showers, a massage, porridge, tea, a national park ticket, and outdoor games for children. The event centre has a warm tent and a luggage storage area. The TKN AFTER PARTY runs until 01:30; the last ferry to Klaipėda departs at 02:20. The event offers various distances, including children’s races and ultramarathons, with aid stations, GPX tracking, medals, and post-race events. Registration closes in mid-September.

description: The Graužikai–Kelmė Run is a traditional run in Kelmė District, held in memory of Vaidotas Rimkus. The event takes place in October and aims to promote running and athletics in Lithuania, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and increase activity among district residents. It attracts runners of all ages, who can choose from several distances, including the 8 km main race. Participants are awarded cups, medals, and commemorative prizes.
course_highlights: The 8 km race starts in Graužikai
A 1.8 km race for girls and boys near the Kelmė Regional Museum
A 200 m children’s race near the museum
additional: The event starts at 12:30, with different distances and start times. Participants should arrive at the Kelmė Regional Museum by 11:30; transport to the start leaves at 12:15. The 200 m children’s race does not require registration. Participants must provide a doctor’s certificate confirming their health status. Winners and runners-up in various age groups receive awards, and everyone who completes a distance receives a commemorative medal. The event will take place at the Kelmė Regional Museum, with registration open until October 16. Participants’ age groups and prizes.

name: Krosas Juodšilių ruduo
description: On October 25, 2025, the “Sporto renginiai” association and the Juodšiliai Eldership of Vilnius District Municipality are organizing the “Juodšilių ruduo” sports festival. The race course includes the forest trail on Mokyklos St. and the forest trails on Šilo St. One lap is 4.5 km long. Race bibs will be handed out and new participants can register from 10:00 to 11:30. Races start at 12:00 with the 600 m run, followed at 12:15 by the 4.5 km, 9 km and 18 km distances.

name: Sporto šventė Juodšilių ruduo
location: Juodšilių, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The “Juodšilių ruduo” sports festival is a Vilnius District sporting event taking place on October 24, 2026, in Juodšiliai. The event encourages community members to take part in sports, promotes athletics and running, and advocates a healthy lifestyle. Anyone may participate, with distances of 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km. Participants register and collect their bibs at the event venue from 10:00 to 11:30. Participation is voluntary, and runners are responsible for their own health.
course_highlights: The course is in the territory of Juodšiliai Eldership, Vilnius District
Events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km cross-country runs
Walking animals and using personal support during the event are prohibited
additional: Bib collection and registration take place from 10:00 to 11:30. Participants must present an identity document to collect their bib. Participants may not transfer their bib to another person, use personal support, walk animals on the course, or leave the course without a judge’s permission. Protests must be submitted in writing within 30 minutes after the end of the event, with a fee of 30 EUR. The fee for changing an event is 6 EUR; changing to a longer event requires payment of the difference. Running events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km; registration from 10:00 to 11:30; participant awards and commemorative medals; participant restrictions and rules.

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: The “Around Lithuania” Run is a traditional running event held in Rumšiškės, on the grounds of the Lithuanian Open-Air Museum. The event offers a range of distances, from a 300 m children’s race to the 21.098 km half marathon, which is the main event and counts toward the Lithuanian Running Cup standings. Participants start according to age-group handicap rules, and the event program includes registration, starts for different distances, and awards. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and compete with running enthusiasts from all over Lithuania.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 300 m children’s race to a 21.098 km half marathon
Starts follow age-group handicap rules
Location: Lithuanian Open-Air Museum in Rumšiškės
additional: Event program: 09:00 registration and race number distribution, 10:45 competition opening, starts for different distances from 11:00 to 13:00, awards from 14:00. The main distance is 21.098 km, consisting of 4 laps. The age-group handicap system allows less competitive participants to start earlier. The event takes place in Rumšiškės, with online registration available. The program includes starts, awards, and special groups.

name: Panevėžio maratonas
description: The Panevėžys Marathon 2024 will take place in Panevėžys, Lithuania, and registration will open on September 13, 2024. Anyone who has registered and had a health check may participate. Participants can choose from various distances: a 400 m walk, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon, with different age requirements.

description: The Varnutė Run is a traditional running event in Jonava, offering routes for participants of all ages. The event has three distances: 2.5 km, 10 km, and 300 m for children, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy running surrounded by the community.

description: The Run for Lithuanian Soldiers’ Day will take place in Tauragė on Saturday, November 17. The event will begin at 11:00 with a 600 m run for children and parents. At 11:20, runners choosing the 1.8 km distance will start, completing three laps of the 600 m course. Participants in the 6 km and 12 km distances will start at 12:00. Registration is open online at www.begimotaure.lt until November 16. Winners in each age group will receive medals and prizes.

name: Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: The Eurovaistinė Christmas Run stands out not only for its festive atmosphere, but also for its distinctive participants, who dress up especially for the running celebration in Christmas (and other!) costumes. This year, the event schedule has been shifted so participants can run after dark, when the capital’s streets will reveal their magical Christmas spirit! We invite you to prepare not only Christmas costumes, but also glowing accessories that will turn the runners into a truly radiant Christmas spectacle!

name: VC TRAIL 2026-11-21 FINALINIS ETAPAS
description: Vilnius Challenge is a unique multisport event held since 2009, giving participants the opportunity to test their physical and psychological limits on a variety of courses. The event includes running, cycling, orienteering, and special physical challenges, offering an adventure in Vilnius’s urban and natural surroundings. Participants can choose a course level to suit their ability, from amateur to extreme courses with a range of obstacles. Vilnius Challenge promotes a healthy lifestyle, teamwork, and community spirit, bringing together sports enthusiasts and people who enjoy an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course includes running, cycling, orienteering, and physical challenges
Participants can choose a course level: amateur, challenge, or extreme
The extreme course features climbing, crawling, swimming, and rappelling
additional: The event centre is the main event venue, where registration, the start, and the finish take place. Participants receive information about the programme and other important details by email in stages. Start times and participant flow may be managed in waves for safety. The event programme and courses may be adjusted for objective reasons. Trail running event with courses at several levels; registration is required. Event date: November 21, 2026.

name: Bėgimas Atgal į Praeitį
location: Vilnius, Laisvalaikio erdvė prie Baltojo tilto
description: Running Back to the Past is a unique event where history becomes the present. All the award medals, trophies, and prizes from previous years’ races are given a second life and new meaning, symbolizing the bond within the running community. The essence of the event is not the novelty of the trophies, but the joy of running and the opportunity to rediscover the meaning of sport. Every participant who completes the full marathon distance will receive a Saulėtekis Marathon neck gaiter.

name: Temple x Nike Winterized Challenge
description: The “Nike Winterized Challenge” with Temple Social is your motivation boost for the cold season. Keep running when the days get shorter and the weather gets colder. Join the Nike and Temple Social running community—we’ll run for 4 weeks, twice a week. Every step counts—earn points, and Nike will reward you with discounts and gifts. Four of you will have the chance to win the new VOMERO GORE-TEX!

name: Saulėtekio maratonas
description: Saulėtekio Marathon 2025 will take place on December 14, 2025, in Vilnius at the VGTU sports complex, Saulėtekio Ave. 28. Several distances will be offered: a 600 m “children’s run,” 4.2 km, 12.6 km, a half marathon (21.1 km), and a marathon (42.2 km). Participants can compete in various age groups, and winners will receive trophies and prizes. The Saulėtekio Marathon slogan: YOUR ONLY LIMIT IS YOU!!!

location: Vingio parko lauko treniruoklių sporto aikštelė
description: Trail START. A free running workout with Monika Mile will take place on December 2 (Tuesday) at 18:30 at the outdoor fitness equipment area in Vingis Park. The workout will last about 1 hour and cover approximately 5 km at an easy pace. It is aimed at beginners who want to learn to run confidently in the forest. The focus will be on technique, feel, and safety in the forest. You must bring running shoes with good tread, weather-appropriate clothing, a headlamp, and a good mood.

name: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026
description: The Advent Running Challenge 2026 is a virtual event taking place from December 1 to 24. Participants receive a new task each day, involving running, physical, accuracy, and creative challenges. The challenge encourages not only speed, but also perseverance, creativity, and engagement throughout all 24 days. Participants compete for the title of Advent Champion and receive a participant kit, with the chance to win prizes from the prize fund.
course_highlights: 24 days with 24 different tasks
Physical, accuracy, and creative challenges
A virtual running challenge with the opportunity to earn points and compete
additional: A participant kit for every participant. Prize fund: €175 (may increase depending on the number of participants). A 24-day challenge with tasks, prizes, and registration via a Google Form.

name: EUROVAISTINĖS Kalėdinis bėgimas
description: EUROVAISTINĖS Christmas Run 2024—the most beautiful winter run, welcoming Christmas and spending time filled with unforgettable emotions and the captivating energy of running! WE RUN on December 7, 2024, in Vilnius. The event stands out for its festive atmosphere and participants dressed in Christmas costumes with glowing accents. This year, participants can run after dark, when the capital’s streets reveal a truly sparkling and magical Christmas spirit.

name: Edgaro atminimui Bėgimas
description: On October 18, we invite everyone to the 11th annual “In Memoriam” run, held to honor the memory of soldiers who died this year. All funds donated during the run will support the families of deceased Lithuanian soldiers. Two championship distances are dedicated to the memory of Lithuanian sports legends: the Felicija Karoblienė Cup (2,000 m for girls) and the Jonas Pipynė Cup (5,000 m for boys).

name: Kauno SK Nemunas 1000 m
description: The Kaunas SK „Nemunas” 1000 m Race Cup will take place on December 14, 2024, in Kaunas. On Saturday, 127 runners competed in the 1000 m event. The top places went to the Youth category: Simas Gedeikis (Kaunas) with a time of 2:38.62 and Viltė Bubinaitė (Vilnius) with 3:04.08. Juniors, younger juniors, and children also took part and achieved excellent results.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard Ultra race designed to help runners cover the 100-mile distance as easily as possible. If you’ve never received a DNF in your life, here’s your chance to earn one with honor. There will be only one winner, so get ready for a challenge in Alytus.

name: Santa Fun Run Šiauliai
description: The Santa Fun Run is a lovely tradition for Šiauliai residents and visitors, with nearly 500 participants dressed as Santa Claus running through the city streets. The run has a noble purpose: all funds raised go to charity. There are no age restrictions, and everyone can easily complete the symbolic 1.3 km distance. At the finish, participants will be in for a surprise: one of Lithuania’s best-known performers, Jovani, will greet the running Santas.

name: Varėnos Kalėdinis pusmaratonis
description: On December 20, 2025, Varėna Sports Center is organizing the Christmas running event “Varėna Christmas Half Marathon.” The event is free, but organizers invite participants, if possible, to contribute a donation to improve the quality of the event. Your support helps us create a festive, smooth, and memorable running event for all participants.

name: Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: On the first Saturday of winter, the annual Eurovaistinė Christmas Run will take place—a running celebration that has been held for 50 years and welcomes thousands of participants. The run stands out not only for its festive atmosphere but also for its distinctive participants, dressed in Christmas costumes. This year, the event schedule has shifted so participants can run after dark, when the sparkling Christmas spirit comes alive on the streets of Vilnius!

name: Kauno „Kalėdinis bėgimas - 2026“
description: The Kaunas Christmas Run is a traditional running event held in Kaunas in December. The event is open to runners of all ages and aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and the popularity of running. The race takes place in Panemunė Forest, and the courses are paved and suitable for both recreational and professional runners. After the run, participants are treated to kūčiukai and tea, and can also use the swimming pool.
course_highlights: Course in Panemunė Forest, Kaunas
Paved surface; snow and ice are possible depending on weather conditions
Choose to run 1.7 km, 5 km (one lap) or 10 km (two laps)
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on race day from 10:00 to 11:40. The entry fee must be paid to the account of the Kaunas Running Club. After the run, participants will be treated to kūčiukai and tea. From 14:30 to 15:30, participants can swim at Žalgiris Swimming Pool (Karaliaus Mindaugo Ave. 50, Kaunas). Registration is permitted only in your own name; bib transfers are prohibited. Registration is open until October 31. Participants will receive personalized bibs. Event date: 2026-12-19

name: Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: On the first Saturday of winter, the annual Eurovaistinė Christmas Run will take place, celebrating its 50th anniversary this year. This running festival will welcome thousands of participants, standing out for its festive atmosphere and distinctive participants dressed in Christmas costumes. The event schedule has been shifted so participants can run after dark, when the magical Christmas spirit comes alive on the streets of Panevėžys. This year, we invite you not only to prepare Christmas costumes but also to add illuminated details that will turn the crowd of runners into a glowing Christmas spectacle.

name: Bėgimas į Naujus
description: Run Into the New Year is an annual race held on the last day of the year. The event brings together runners and enthusiasts who want to celebrate the arrival of the New Year actively. Participants can choose from different distances, allowing everyone to find a challenge that suits them. The route offers beautiful city sights and a unique atmosphere created by participants and spectators.

name: Pažadų Bėgimas
description: PROMISE RUN. We continue the tradition started in 2018. On the morning of 2026-01-01, while the sound of fireworks still echoes in your ears, confirm to yourself during the run that your New Year’s resolutions will really come true. No competition, registration, medals or prizes—just you and your New Year’s “PROMISES.” Run 10 km and write down your goals so you can check on 2027-01-01 whether they came true. The start will take place on 2026-01-01 at 14:00 at Kaunas Santaka Stadium.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai invites all club members and friends to the 1st New Year’s SEALS MARATHON, which will take place in Pasvalys. This marathon is part of the traditional 18th ice-swimming event organized in Pasvalys District. After the marathon, a club members’ meeting will be held, during which the club’s most active members will be awarded.

name: XIV Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas
location: Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryža, Jonava, Lithuania
description: The 14th traditional Jonava New Year’s Run will take place on January 1, 2027. The start is at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets. The traditional 20 km course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala, and the finish is on Kauno Street near the treatment facilities. The event features a hilly course and winter conditions. After the run, participants are invited to enjoy tea and snacks and collect commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Traditional 20 km running course
Start at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets
The course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala, with the finish on Kauno Street
additional: After the run, participants receive trophies and prizes, commemorative medals, and can enjoy tea and snacks. The course is hilly, and in winter it may be slippery and windy. The course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala; the weather is often wintry, and the event is popular with local runners as a way to start the new year.

name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run 2026 is a fast, flat 5K taking place on New Year’s Day, January 1, 2026, at 10:15 a.m. in Galway city centre. The route passes through the city centre, starting at the Claddagh, crossing Wolfe Tone Bridge, and continuing along Merchants Road and through the Docks before returning via Grattan Road and the Prom, with a fast finish in South Park, beside Nimmo’s Pier. The route passes many of the city’s most iconic attractions. The race is AAI-certified.

name: Resolution Run 2026
description: Resolution Run 2027 invites you to start the new year with energy and activity. It’s a great opportunity to keep your New Year’s resolutions by running alongside a crowd of enthusiastic runners. The event promises good spirits, smiles, and a fun start to the year in Kaunas.
course_highlights: Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Warm-up for participants in all distances
Run on routes through Kaunas
additional: Distribution of participants’ race packs and awards are scheduled in the event programme. The event will include an official opening and a warm-up for participants in all distances. The event takes place in Kaunas and is organised by VšĮ Kauno maratono klubas. Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km; the event takes place in Kaunas; the organiser offers a festive start and a sense of community.

name: LBT Kėdainiai
location: Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1.)
description: Kėdainiai Sports Centre is organizing LBT 1 – the New Year’s Run “KĖDAINIAI 2025,” which will take place on January 5 at 12:00 at the Kėdainiai Central Stadium grounds (J. Basanavičiaus St. 1). The running distances include a 400 m children’s run and 4 km and 8.5 km courses.

images.alt_text: Naujametinis bėgimas "Kėdainiai 2025" plakatas su informacija apie datą, vietą ir distancijas.
Bėgimo lenktynės Kėdainiuose, startas. Sportininkai bėga stadione.
Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas, kur vyks bėgimo varžybos.
LBT I Kėdainiai apdovanojimai.

name: Gyvybės ir Mirties bėgimas
description: On Saturday, the 31st edition of the “Road of Life and Death” run honoring the victims of the January 13 events took place in Vilnius, with around 6,000 people taking part. The “Road of Life and Death” run has been held annually since 1992 and was canceled only in 2021 due to COVID-19 restrictions. The record number of participants was reached three years ago, when more than 8,000 runners gathered for the event.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo dalyviai prie TV bokšto su medaliais ir vėliava.
Bėgimo renginio nuotrauka. Dalyviai ir kariškiai pagerbia žuvusiuosius už laisvę.
Bėgimo „Gyvybės ir Mirties keliu“ logotipas su bėgikais, TV bokštu ir simboliais.
XXVI Pagarbos bėgimas „Gyvybės ir Mirties keliu“ logotipas.

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: The XXV Run Commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day in Klaipėda is a traditional running event held to honour those who died and fought for Lithuania’s freedom. The event brings together the city’s community and visitors and takes place in Klaipėda on January 18. Participants can choose between two distances: the main 8 km course and a shorter 3 km course for schoolchildren, seniors and anyone who finds the longer course too challenging. The event starts in the evening, and the routes pass through scenic parts of the city, including a cycle path and the Summer Amphitheatre.
course_highlights: The 8 km course follows a cycle path past Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre, Liepojos Street and H. Manto Street
Finish near Klaipėda City Municipality (Liepų St. 11)
The 3 km course starts near Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre and is intended for schoolchildren and seniors
additional: Race bibs have an external timing chip. Picking up race bibs in advance is recommended to avoid queues on event day. Bib pickup for 8 km runners is on a bus near the Rotušė, and for 3 km runners it is near the Summer Amphitheatre. Buses depart for the start locations at 19:00. Individual warm-up: 19:45–19:55. The course closes at 21:20. Medals are awarded to the first 900 finishers. The event is organised with buses and community participation; the start is at the Klaipėda Giruliai Radio and TV Tower.

name: Aplink Želvos ežerą
description: The “Around Lake Želva” run will take place on January 11, 2025, in Suginčiai (Molėtai District), in remembrance of Lithuania’s Freedom Defenders Day. The event aims to promote running in Lithuania, improve athletic performance, and encourage a healthy, active lifestyle. We recommend arriving at around 10:00; the race starts at 11:00.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard Ultra-style race designed to make it easier for runners to cover 100 miles. If you’ve never experienced a DNF in your life, here you’ll have the chance to earn one with honor. There will be only one winner.

name: VI Utenos sporto arenos maratonas
description: The Utena Arena Marathon is a unique indoor marathon held in the city of Utena. Participants run 182.5 laps of 231.3 metres, offering a distinctive opportunity to experience a marathon in a controlled environment. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs looking to test their endurance and speed. It is a traditional annual event that promotes sportsmanship and community spirit.
course_highlights: Indoor venue – the race takes place inside the arena
182.5 laps of 231.3 metres
A controlled environment unaffected by weather conditions
additional: Registration takes place only on the event day at the start venue; advance registration is not available. The event will take place in Utena, Lithuania, on February 7, 2027; the event description highlights community spirit and a variety of running events.

name: 15-asis bėgimas „Žiema Jonavoje“
description: The 15th “Winter in Jonava” run invites runners to a traditional winter event in the surroundings of Jonava. The event takes place on cycling paths around the Jonava ponds, offering an opportunity to enjoy winter scenery and active leisure. It is a great chance for both experienced and beginner runners to test their endurance and enjoy a community atmosphere. The event takes place in February, when winter is still fully present in nature.
course_highlights: Run around the Jonava ponds
The route follows cycling paths
Winter scenery and fresh air
additional: The event attracts participants from various cities across Lithuania, and is open to all age groups. The 2024 event had 88 participants, and the scenic routes are suitable for runners of various levels.

name: Trailo kalvės S4E4. Prienai

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alavinė jaunimo kategorijos 3,15 € + 0,08 € bilieto paslaugos mokestis

description: Trailo Kalvė S4E4 Prienai is a winter trail running event held at the Giraitiškės recreation area in Prienai. This stage traditionally took place in autumn, but this season participants are invited to take on the course in winter. The event offers routes of various lengths for runners of different ages and experience levels, from children to adults. It is part of the Trailo Kalvė Cup, which features routes of varying difficulty and elevation gain.
course_highlights: Routes from 5 km to 23 km, with varying elevation gain
The winter season offers a unique opportunity to run on snow-covered forest trails
Start at the Giraitiškės recreation area, Prienai
additional: There are no medals, but participants registering for the first time this season receive a Trailo Kalvė running band. The event takes place in winter, so the routes are snow-covered and require special preparation. Registration is available only for team participants; regular tickets are recommended for individual entries. Participants are encouraged to register in teams. The event takes place at the Giraitiškės recreation area, and the course is run in winter conditions.

name: Bėgimas varžybos „Bėgame už Laisvę“ 2026
description: The “We Run for Freedom” race is a unique running event in Mažeikiai, held to commemorate February 16, the Day of the Restoration of the State of Lithuania. The event promotes an active lifestyle, community, and the celebration of freedom. Participants are invited to join this traditional celebration and run together for freedom.
course_highlights: 10 km road race
The event takes place in Mažeikiai
Held to commemorate February 16
additional: All runners are advised to gather at the 200 m start at 11:35. The event includes various age groups; registration takes place at M. Račkauskas Gymnasium, and participants receive medals.

name: Respublikinis bėgimas „Pabaiskas - Ukmergė“, skirtas Lietuvos Valstybės atkūrimo dienai
location: Ukmergė, Ukmergė district municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The national run “Pabaiskas - Ukmergė” commemorates the Day of the Restoration of the State of Lithuania and takes place in Ukmergė. This traditional event attracts running enthusiasts from across Lithuania and aims to promote civic spirit, active leisure and running. The races include an 11.6 km distance starting in Pabaiskas and a 3 km race for students at the Ukmergė Hippodrome. After the finish, participants receive medals, and the event concludes with the awards ceremony and tea.
course_highlights: 11.6 km distance starting in Pabaiskas
3 km race for students at the Ukmergė Hippodrome
Finish at the Ukmergė Sports Centre Stadium
additional: Race-number pickup takes place in the sports hall at the Ukmergė Sports Centre Stadium from 9:30 to 11:00. The bus to Pabaiskas departs at 11:15. After the finish, all participants receive commemorative medals, and the youngest and oldest participants are recognized. The race winners receive cups and medals. Participants are responsible for their own health, or responsibility lies with the people accompanying them. Concerts, exhibitions and other cultural events also take place in Ukmergė during the event, which draws around 120 runners.

name: Klajoklio maratonas #25: Kūjagalviai
price_range: dalyvių startinis mokestis negrąžinamas, registracijos perleidimas 5€
description: The KLAJOKLIS Marathon is a traditional running event in Lithuania, held in various locations since 2020. The event brings running enthusiasts together for unique marathons where they can experience different natural and urban settings. Each year, the marathon takes place in a different location in Lithuania, and the 25th marathon in 2027 will be held in Kūjagalviai. The event is for both experienced runners and amateurs looking to test their endurance and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: The marathon is held in various locations across Lithuania, offering a unique experience each year
The Kūjagalviai Marathon course is known for its natural beauty and challenges for runners
The event attracts both professional and amateur runners from all over Lithuania
additional: running event in Kūjagalviai, awards, post-race entertainment

name: XXXVII tradicinis bėgimas „Obeliskas A. Kulviečiui – Jonava“
location: Jonava, Jonava District Municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The traditional “Obeliskas A. Kulviečiui - Jonava” race is a Lithuanian Running Cup event held in Jonava. It invites recreational and professional runners to take part in various distances, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting spirit. The race is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup, which includes several stages across the country. The event is organised by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė to promote running and encourage people to take part in competitions regularly.
course_highlights: More than 1,100 participants from Lithuania and abroad
Traditional distances: 2 km and 15 km
Events and concerts commemorating March 11
additional: Registrations are administered and entry fees collected by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another participant no later than the closing of advance registration; a fee of 10 euros applies. The first race stage starts at 08:00. The event is a Lithuanian Running Cup stage and offers awards and a photo gallery. Runners of all age groups are invited to participate.

name: Bėgimas „Pamario taurė“
location: Šilutė, Šilutės rajonas, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lietuva

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registracija NEMOKAMA, atidaroma 2026 m. vasario 10 d., sustabdoma 2026 m. kovo 8 d., 22.00 val.

description: The “Pamario Cup” run is a traditional event in Šilutė, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and popularizing running. The event is organized by Šilutė District Municipality together with local sports organizations. Participants are invited to run various distances, including a 400 m children’s course in the city center by the municipality. The event has a friendly atmosphere and aims to bring together both local residents and visitors.
course_highlights: Start by Šilutė District Municipality
Children’s course – 400 m in the city center
Participants run with electronic timing
additional: Race bibs are distributed on race day by Šilutė Cultural Center and on March 10 at the reception desk of Šilutė Leisure and Sports Center. Children participating in the run may be accompanied by one parent or guardian. Each participant must attach their bib, which contains an electronic timing chip, to the front of their shirt. The event takes place in Šilutė and is often associated with Lithuania’s Independence Day; it has about 500 participants, offers various distances, and awards prizes.

name: 2026 metų Kovo 11-osios bėgimas, skirtas Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės atkūrimo dienai paminėti
location: Gargždų kultūros centras, Gargždai, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
price_range: nemokamai iki IV grupės, 4-5 eurai vėlesnėms grupėms

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: I-III grupės dalyviai ir pensininkai - nemokamai

description: The 2026 March 11 Run is dedicated to commemorating Lithuania’s Restoration of Independence Day and aims to encourage the public to take part in sports and identify the strongest runners in various age groups. The event takes place near Gargždai Cultural Centre, and participants can choose from different distances according to their age and fitness level. The run is open to everyone, with participants starting in groups between 10:00 and 10:30. This traditional event promotes physical activity and brings the community together to mark an important date.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Gargždai Cultural Centre
Different distances from 1.3 km to 14.3 km, according to age group
The course consists of laps, with the number run determined by age group
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 8:45 to 9:30. Participants start in two groups: Groups I–III at 10:00, and Groups IV–V at 10:30. Registration is online only and closes on March 10 at 20:00. Participants may not be accompanied by bicycles or other vehicles during the run; directional markers will be placed along the course. Various race courses, online registration, awards, traffic management during the event.

name: Nuotykių lenktynės „Aplink Rėkyvos ežerą“
description: The “Around Lake Rėkyva” adventure race is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup, held in Šiauliai by Lake Rėkyva. It is a run approximately 14.5 km long, intended for recreational and professional runners, with the aim of promoting running and encouraging a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in spring and is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup series, which includes various races throughout Lithuania. Participants are invited to test their abilities and enjoy the natural scenery around the lake.
course_highlights: An approximately 14.5 km route around Lake Rėkyva
The race takes place in Šiauliai, surrounded by nature
A Lithuanian Running Cup stage for both recreational and professional runners
additional: The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another participant until advance registration closes, subject to a €10 change fee. Registration and entry fee administration is handled by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The event took place on 2026-03-15, but the planned date is 2027-03-21; the course is not marked, participants choose their own route, and navigation and tactics are important.

name: Riešės krosas
location: Riešės hipodrome, Vilniaus r., Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Riešė Cross is a traditional cross-country running event held at the Riešė Hippodrome in Vilnius District. The event aims to promote cross-country running and athletics, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and increase physical activity. The course is 100% natural, comprising the hippodrome track, field paths, forest trails, and grass, making for a varied and hilly run. Participants are divided into age groups, and all finishers receive commemorative souvenirs, while age-group winners receive prizes.
course_highlights: 100% natural surface: hippodrome track, field paths, forest trail, and grass
Hilly course, with possible mud or snow depending on weather conditions
Different lap counts according to age groups and distances
additional: Race numbers will be issued on race day from 09:30 to 10:50 near the start-finish area. The race program may change depending on the number of participants; any changes will be announced when race numbers are collected. Participants are responsible for their own health, while parents or guardians are responsible for minors. All finishers receive commemorative souvenirs, and age-group winners and runners-up receive medals, cash prizes, and other prizes. The event will take place on 2027-03-27 at the Riešė Hippodrome in Vilnius District and is intended to encourage an active lifestyle and a sense of community.

name: ULTRA 55 !!!
location: Bėgimo namai Kūjagalviai, Kauno rajonas, Lithuania
description: ULTRA 55!!! is a birthday ultrarun held to honour the 55th birthday of Vidas Totilas, a long-time advocate of running. The event takes place at Bėgimo namai in Kūjagalviai, Kaunas District, and aims to promote long-distance running in Lithuania and grow the long-distance running community. The course follows forest and field tracks, with sandy sections; the start and finish are at the same location. Anyone may participate, regardless of age, gender or nationality, and participation is free.
course_highlights: Forest and field tracks
Sandy sections along the course
Start and finish at Bėgimo namai in Kūjagalviai
additional: Registration is available online and on race day from 9:30 to 10:55. Participation is free. All finishers receive commemorative medals, with awards in the overall and age-group categories. After the finish, participants can enjoy hot soup, snacks and drinks, as well as a sauna and hot tub. The event is part of the Bėgimo namai race series, is held annually and attracts experienced ultrarunners.

name: Bėgimas „Runway Run 2026“
location: Lietuvos oro pajėgų bazė, Šiauliai, Lithuania
description: Runway Run 2026 is a 3 km run held at the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. The event offers a unique opportunity to run on a runway, an unusual and exciting place to race. It is intended for school pupils, college students, the community, and the public, promoting an active lifestyle and sports. Participants can enjoy the distinctive atmosphere and test their abilities on this special course.
course_highlights: 3 km run on a runway
Location: Lithuanian Air Force Base, Šiauliai
Unique running course within the airport grounds
additional: The event is intended for school pupils, college students, the college community, and the public. Registration is open, but prices and registration deadlines were not specified. Free parking spaces may be available for students. The event takes place in a setting organized by Šiauliai State College. The event date is April 3, 2027; the distance is 3 km; the location is the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. Registration details were not specified.

name: Trailo kalvės S4E5. Bražuolė. Finalas
description: Trailo Kalvė S4E5 Bražuolė Finalas is the final event of the traditional Lithuanian Trail Running Cup season, held in the Bražuolė area. The event offers a range of distances for participants of different ages and experience levels, from youth to adults. The courses wind through woodland and vary in length and difficulty, offering both natural beauty and challenges. Participants start at the Bražuolė campsite, and the event is friendly and open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Woodland courses in the Bražuolė area
Distances of varying lengths, from 4.8 km to 24.8 km
Courses with varied elevation gain and scenic natural views
additional: Start at the Bražuolė campsite. Courses feature elevation gains ranging from up to 150 m to over 500 m, depending on the distance. The event has youth and adult categories. Event merchandise is inspired by forest animals, and part of the proceeds goes to support care organizations. The event offers different distances, registration is online, and the location is Bražuolė campsite, Pugainiai.

name: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“
location: Senvagė and Kultūros ir poilsio parkas, Panevėžys, Lithuania
description: The traditional “Senvagė-2026” running competition is part of a Lithuanian Running Cup stage and takes place in Panevėžys, in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park. The event brings together running enthusiasts from various cities to promote sports, a healthy lifestyle, and the discovery of the natural and cultural beauty of Lithuania’s regions. The competition is part of the long-standing Lithuanian Running Cup tradition, which has brought together professional and amateur runners across the country since 2009. The event takes place in spring, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: The competition takes place in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park in Panevėžys
A traditional Lithuanian Running Cup stage featuring runners from various cities
Encourages participants to discover the nature and architecture of Lithuania’s regions
additional: Registration is managed by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another person no later than the close of advance registration. If changing from a more expensive to a less expensive distance, the price difference is non-refundable. The participant change fee is 10 euros. The event will take place at Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, with online registration available.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Pasaulinei sveikatos dienai paminėti
organizer: Lietuvos sporto draugija „Žalgiris“ ir Kėdainių sporto centras
description: Kėdainiai Sports Centre invites everyone to take part in a run celebrating World Health Day. This is a community-focused, active event aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity, and strengthening the physical and mental health of the community. It is a great opportunity for families, children, young people, and older adults to come together and spend time actively in Kėdainiai. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Programme, which supports the organization of mass physical activity events.
course_highlights: Physical activity sessions
Health screenings
Community engagement
additional: The event is open to all age groups—families, children, young people, and older residents. It is organized by the Lithuanian Sports Society „Žalgiris“ and Kėdainiai Sports Centre. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Programme, which promotes mass participation in physical activity. It includes a range of physical activity sessions, screenings, sports competitions, and lectures, and will take place in the city of Kėdainiai, with the central city stadium as the main venue.

name: Bėgimas „Tropem Wilczym 2026“
organizer: Lenkijos Respublikos ambasada Vilniuje, Lietuvos lenkų jaunimas, asociacija „Sporto renginiai“
description: The international “Tropem Wilczym 2026” run will take place in Vingis Park, Vilnius, and is dedicated to honoring members of the anti-Nazi, anti-communist, and anti-Soviet underground. The event promotes running and athletics in Lithuania, encourages a healthy lifestyle, and aims to bring together runners of all ages. Participants can choose from several distances, and the event is organized with a strong focus on safety and professionalism. It is a great opportunity for both professionals and amateurs to take part in a meaningful sporting event.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Vingis Park near the band shell
Distances: the symbolic 1963 m run, 5.2 km, 10.5 km, and a half marathon
The course will be closed and traffic restrictions introduced to ensure safety
additional: On race day, the timing system will operate until 13:30; after that, times will not be recorded. The number of participants is limited to 1,200. It is possible to switch to a shorter distance for a €2 fee. Participants must bring an ID document to collect their race bib. The event combines sport and history, offers several distances, including the symbolic 1,963-metre course, and emphasizes the importance of community. Participant age groups apply, and the use of vehicles or personal escorts is prohibited.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė
location: Baltoji Vokė, Rūdiškių seniūnija, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The traditional international Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė run is an annual spring sports celebration held in Baltoji Vokė. This traditional race brings together running enthusiasts from Lithuania and abroad. The event has a long history and a friendly atmosphere that encourages an active lifestyle and community spirit.
course_highlights: Traditional Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė route
Part of the spring sports celebration
Held annually since at least 2018
additional: The event takes place during the spring sports celebration. Registration is managed by the Lithuanian Running Cup. In previous years, the start time was usually 11:00. Several hundred athletes take part; the event includes awards, sponsor support, and safety arrangements.

name: Kauno Akropolio maratonas 2026
description: The Kauno Akropolis Marathon is an annual international running event in Kaunas, attracting thousands of participants. The event is for everyone, regardless of age or fitness level, and aims to promote social and physical activity and healthy-lifestyle traditions in Lithuania. The marathon and half-marathon courses are certified by World Athletics (WA) and the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS). It is a sporting celebration for both professionals and recreational runners, held in a safe environment that meets high standards.
course_highlights: The marathon and half-marathon courses are certified by WA and AIMS
The course is measured according to international standards
The event is certified with a 5-star quality label
additional: The event is certified with a 5-star quality label, ensuring the highest standards of safety and service. The marathon courses meet international standards. The event is for both professionals and recreational runners and takes place in Kaunas. It is organized by the public institution "Kauno maratono klubas". The event offers a virtual running option, group registration, various distances, and certified courses.

name: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“
description: The Palanga Half Marathon “OUTRUN THE HORSE” is a high-quality half-marathon event held in celebration of St. George’s Day. The event aims to establish Palanga as a European City of Sport and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The race takes place in the resorts of Palanga and Šventoji, expanding the range of mass sporting events and encouraging local community participation in sports.
course_highlights: Start in Šventoji and finish in Palanga
The course is marked and adapted for runners
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and popularizes sports
additional: Traffic restrictions and public relations campaigns are planned to ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: SwampMan Backyard ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė
description: SwampMan Backyard Ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė is a unique endurance race in Alytus, near Lake Dailidė. The event invites runners to test their limits on a Backyard Ultra course, a format that makes it easier to reach the 100-mile distance. There will be only one winner, and the challenge is demanding—things seem easy only up to a certain point. It is a great opportunity to experience the true spirit of endurance running and earn DNF status with honour.
course_highlights: Trail run around Lake Dailidė
Backyard Ultra endurance format, designed for reaching 100 miles
Race venue in Alytus, on the slopes of Vidzgiris
additional: The race regulations are available in PDF format. The event takes place in Alytus, near Lake Dailidė. More than 120 participants. The race follows the Backyard Ultra format, in which the winner is the last runner remaining. The event venue is Lake Dailidė in Alytus; the course is approximately 6.7 km long, with wooded and paved sections. Participants may bring their own tent. Car and camper parking is available outside the start area. Food and drinks are available during the event.

name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: The 63rd traditional “Anykščiai - Puntukas Stone - Anykščiai” race invites participants to spend May 7 actively amid the beautiful landscapes of the Anykščiai region. The race distances and difficulty levels are suited to participants of different ages and fitness levels, from a fun run for children to an 11 km challenge for endurance runners. The event is the oldest in Lithuania and is renowned for its tradition and friendly atmosphere, attracting sports enthusiasts from across the country. Participants will receive commemorative medals, while the fastest runners in the 11 km distance will win cash prizes.
course_highlights: A scenic route through the Anykščiai landscape, winding through the Anykščiai Forest celebrated in the poetry of Antanas Baranauskas
Distances for all abilities: from 300 m for children to 11 km for endurance runners
Start near the Angels Museum in Anykščiai
additional: Starts by age group: 10:30 — children’s fun run “Puntukėlis”; 11:30 — 3 km distance; 11:50 — race opening ceremony; 12:00 — 6 km and 11 km distances. Registration is open only until April 28 at 12:00; registration will not be available on race day. Participants who finish will receive commemorative medals. The fastest runners in the 11 km distance will receive cash prizes. Participants are offered advance registration, the opportunity to recover after the race in a swimming pool and sauna complex, prizes and discounts, and various age groups.

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėda EKOMarathon is a traditional running event held on the forest trails of Giruliai in Klaipėda. Both amateur and professional runners can take part, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. Distances range from 2 km for schoolchildren to 42.2 km for Ekomarathon participants, who run 10 laps of 4.2 km each. The event is organized by the Klaipėda city running club “Maratonas” and supported by Klaipėda City Municipality.
course_highlights: Ekomarathon course: 10 laps of 4.2 km on the forest trails of Giruliai
Schoolchildren’s course: 2 km (1 km out, 1 km back)
Start in Giruliai Forest, at the beginning of the bike path beyond the Summer Stage
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 15:00. The entry fee is paid on site when collecting the race number. The first 300 participants receive commemorative medals; all participants receive certificates. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Participants agree that event organizers may use photographs and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. 4.2 km and 42.2 km distances, 2 km schoolchildren’s race, start in Giruliai Forest, online registration until April 30.

name: Vilnius trail run 2026
distance_verbose: 100 km, 100 km, 73 km, 70 km, Maratonas, Pusmaratonas, Pusmaratonas, 15 km, 5 km, 1.8 km
description: Vilnius Trail Run 2027 invites runners to experience a unique variety of courses in Vilnius’s natural surroundings and urban environment. The event offers routes ranging from 15+ km for beginners to a challenging 108 km course around Vilnius. Participants can enjoy varied terrain, including forest trails, mountain roads, and scenic viewpoints offering unforgettable views of the Lithuanian landscape. It is a great opportunity to test your endurance and discover the city’s nature and culture while running.
course_highlights: Unique routes in Vilnius from 15+ km to 108 km
Varied terrain: forest trails and mountain roads
Scenic viewpoints with views of the Lithuanian landscape
additional: The event takes place at Kalnų Park Stadium, T. Kosciuškos g. 5, Vilnius. The number of participants exceeds 1,000. Organizer: VšĮ, address: Balžio g. 21C-5, Vilnius, telephone: +370 610 24484. The event offers courses featuring forest trails, mountain tracks, and scenic viewpoints; participants can choose from various distances and age groups, including an ultramarathon and children’s races.

name: Vilniaus pavasario maratonas
description: The Vilnius Spring Marathon invites runners of all levels to test their strength in the springtime atmosphere of Vilnius’s Vingis Park. The event offers a range of distances, from a 600 m children’s race to the classic 42.195 km marathon, as well as a half marathon and shorter races. It’s a great opportunity to kick off the running season surrounded by nature, moving through the city and its parks while enjoying the renewal of spring. The event is organized with great attention to all participants’ experience and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Vingis Park amphitheatre
Run through Vilnius city parks and streets
Distances from a 600 m children’s race to the 42.195 km marathon
additional: The event takes place on 2026-05-02, with the start at 10:00 at the Vingis Park amphitheatre. Distances: 42.195 km, 21.098 km, 10.6 km, 5.3 km, and 600 m for children. The regulations are available at https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis/nuostatai/. Registration is available at https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis. The event offers various distances, including races for children and young people, as well as the option to participate with insurance. Registration is through myrace.lt.

name: RASA Druskininkų maratonas
organizer: Asociacija Sporto renginiai ir Druskininkų sporto centras
description: The RASA Druskininkai Marathon is an international running event held in Druskininkai by Lake Vijūnėlė. The event promotes running as a healthy lifestyle, aims to popularize athletics in Lithuania, and encourages greater physical activity among Druskininkai residents. Anyone may take part in the competition, but participants in the marathon and half marathon must be at least 18 years old. Runners can choose from distances ranging from 500 m to the marathon, and all participants receive special event medals.
course_highlights: 500 m, 5 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, and marathon distances
Starts from 10:00; time limits are 5 hours for the marathon and half marathon distances
The race takes place by Lake Vijūnėlė in Druskininkai
additional: Starts take place in waves: 10:00 – 500 m (untimed); 10:17 – 5 km (43-minute time limit); 11:00 – 10.5 km, half marathon, and marathon (5-hour time limit). Participants must compete under their own names. Participants in the marathon and half marathon must be at least 18 years old. All participants receive special event medals, and trophies are awarded to the top three finishers. Distances: 500 m, 5 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, marathon; online registration; awards for the top finishers.

name: Red Bull Wings for Life World run
description: Red Bull Wings for Life World Run is a unique race held simultaneously around the world, including in Vingis Park in Vilnius. Participants run as far as they can until they are caught by the Catcher Car. The event supports research into spinal cord injuries, with 100% of the entry fee going to research. Join thousands of runners around the world and run for those who can’t.
course_highlights: The run takes place in Vingis Park, Vilnius
Starts simultaneously with runners around the world
A unique Catcher Car format that ends the run
additional: The start is at 11:00 UTC. Participants run as far as they can until they are caught by the Catcher Car. 100% of the entry fee goes to research into spinal cord injuries. The event takes place simultaneously around the world, including in Vilnius. It takes place in Vingis Park; participants can choose to run or walk; there is no traditional finish line; funds are raised for spinal cord injury research.

name: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos
organizer: Lietuvos lengvosios atletikos federacija, Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubas, Lietuvos sporto universitetas
description: The A. Vietrinas Cup running race is held in memory of Alfonso Vietrinas, a pioneer of marathon running in Lithuania. The race takes place in Kaunas Oak Grove Park, with the start and finish by the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas. Participants can choose between the 2.5 km and 10 km distances. The course is certified and consists of a 2.5 km loop. The event promotes running in Lithuania and welcomes everyone who has a doctor’s approval to participate.
course_highlights: The course runs through Oak Grove Park
The certified course is a 2.5 km loop
Start and finish by the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas
additional: The 2.5 km race starts at 11:30, and the 10 km race starts at 12:00. Participants must wear their race number on the front of their shirt. Age-group winners and placing participants, as well as the youngest and oldest participants, receive commemorative cups. The use of vehicles and personal escorts is prohibited during the race. The event aims to encourage physical activity and build a community of running enthusiasts in Lithuania.

name: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Kresowe Trail“
location: Nemenčinės apylinkės, Nemenčinė, Vilniaus rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: Vilniaus rajono savivaldybė, Vilniaus rajono sporto centras, Vilniaus rajono sporto mokykla, fondas Maratony Kresowe
description: The international “Kresowe Trail” running competition in Nemenčinė offers a unique opportunity to run through the surroundings of the Vilnius District Sports Centre. The competition takes place on June 2, with routes of varying lengths—from the shorter 6 km Szpurt run to the longer 18.6 km Wertep route. The event is suitable for both professional and recreational runners, with electronic timing and a race bib valid for the entire season. Participants can enjoy routes marked with green and red arrows, and awards and hot food await after the run.
course_highlights: Szpurt 6 km run marked with green arrows on a yellow background
Wertep 18.6 km run marked with red arrows
Two refreshment stations on the Wertep route
additional: Registration takes place before the start, from 8:30 to 9:20, no later than 10 minutes before the start. The race office is open on June 1 from 15:00 to 18:00 at the Vilnius District Sports Centre. The course time limit is 2 hours 15 minutes. Electronic timing and a free race bib with a timing chip, valid for the entire season. Hot food is offered to participants after the run. Starting areas are separated by distance: Szpurt 6 km and Wertep 19 km. The event includes refreshment stations, electronic timing, a free race bib, medical coverage, and awards.

name: Šventinis bėgimas „Kuršėnams 463“
location: Kuršėnų pėsčiųjų tiltas, Kuršėnai, Šiaulių rajonas, Lithuania
price_range: nemokamai, 3-5 Eur, registracijos mokestis iki 2026-05-13 d. 23:59, vėliau 10 Eur
