description: The festive “Kuršėnams 463” run is a traditional running event held in Kuršėnai, Šiauliai District. The event aims to promote running and encourage a healthy lifestyle, inviting runners of all ages to take part. The races take place by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge, with three distances on offer: approximately 463 m, 2.5 km, and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a symbolic route and a friendly atmosphere, and the event concludes with awards and a joint finish at around 21:30.
course_highlights: A symbolic route of approximately 463 m by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge
A 2.5 km loop that 10 km runners complete four times
The races take place in an urban setting, with a convenient start and finish
additional: Race schedule: 19:30 — 463 m start; 19:40 — 2.5 km start; 20:00 — 10 km start. Awards take place after the last participant finishes, at around 21:30. Participants must be healthy or have a doctor’s clearance to exercise. The health and conduct of underage participants are supervised by accompanying adults. The race takes place by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge; registration and race-number pickup are by the bridge; participant age groups; COVID-19 safety requirements.

name: HANNER bėgimas į dangoraižį „Europa“
location: Europa Tower, Vilnius, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The HANNER Run Up the Europa Skyscraper is a traditional annual challenge, inviting running enthusiasts and extreme sports fans to climb all 31 floors of the Europa business centre, the tallest in the Baltic States. The event brings together professionals and amateurs looking to improve their endurance and athletic performance. The course must be completed in no more than 10 minutes, while prize winners usually finish in 3–4 minutes. The fastest runners receive cash prizes and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: 31 floors of the business centre up to the terrace
Course completion time: up to 10 minutes
Records stand at 2 min. 55.6 sec. in the men’s category and 3 min. 28.6 sec. in the women’s category
additional: Participants start every half-minute to avoid congestion. The fastest runners receive cash prizes and gifts from sponsors. The event is organised by real estate development company Hanner and the Lithuanian Running Cup team. The event is scheduled for May 22, 2027, and welcomes participants from across Lithuania and abroad. Participants are invited to climb Europa Tower, and the event is known as one of the most interesting and challenging running events in Vilnius.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 1 etapas
description: The Jonava Running Cup is a traditional running competition held in Jonava District to promote sport and physical activity. The event is open to all runners from Lithuania and abroad and takes place in five stages at different locations. Participants compete in both the overall standings and age groups, while the routes pass through various parts of Jonava District, offering an interesting and varied running experience. Registration is online, and race numbers can be collected at the start location on race day.
course_highlights: Five stages at different locations in Jonava District: Šilai–Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai–Bartoniai, Jonava
Starts and finishes at various locations, including Jonava Central Stadium and eldership buildings
Races take place in the evening, with the start at 19:30 and race-number collection from 18:30 to 19:20
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the start location on race day from 18:30 to 19:20. Registration is carried out separately for each stage. Participation is free. The event is open to all participants, offers online registration and different routes, and takes place in five stages from May to September.

name: Kėdainių bėgimas „Babėnų pavasaris 2026“
location: Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelė, Kėdainiai, Lithuania
description: The Kėdainiai race “Babėnų Spring 2026” invites all active-lifestyle enthusiasts to take part in the 5 km and 10 km distances at the Babėnai Forest recreation area. The event aims to encourage physical activity among participants of all ages and provide an opportunity to compete and put their running abilities to the test. The courses follow forest trails and paths, and every finisher will receive a commemorative medal. The competition is organised in cooperation between the Kėdainiai Sports Centre and the Lithuanian Amateur Runners Association.
course_highlights: The courses follow trails and paths in Babėnai Forest
5 km and 10 km distances
The competition takes place at the Babėnai Forest recreation area, at the end of Aušros and Budrio streets
additional: Additional registration will be available at the start area from 17:00 to 18:15. Race numbers will be issued starting one hour before the start, with distribution ending 15 minutes before the start. Winners and runners-up in each age group will be awarded, as will the three fastest participants in the 5 km and 10 km distances. All finishers will receive commemorative medals. The event is planned for 26 May 2027, but no details about the courses or entry fee have been provided.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“
description: The traditional “Laisvės taku 2026” run will take place on May 22, 2026, in the town of Šimkaičiai, Jurbarkas District, to mark the 117th anniversary of the birth of General Jonas Žemaitis. This is an 11 km cross-country race starting at General Jonas Žemaitis’s command post. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and honours the memory of a Lithuanian freedom fighter. Participants are invited to register in advance and take part in this community sporting event.
course_highlights: An 11 km cross-country race in the Šimkaičiai area
Start at General Jonas Žemaitis’s command post
Bus transport to the start from Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School
additional: Participant registration is open from 9:00 to 9:30. Bib pickup is on 2025-05-23 from 9:00 to 9:30. Registration venue: Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School. The bus to the start leaves from the school at 09:45. Awards are scheduled for 13:00. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or have had a health check. Results will be published publicly. Photos and video footage will be taken during the event for marketing purposes. The event will take place at Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School; age groups and online registration are available.

name: If Vilniaus Pusmaratonis 2026
description: The “If” Vilnius Half Marathon is Vilnius’s biggest spring running festival, held in the city’s Old Town. The event welcomes runners of all ages, from children to half-marathon participants. It promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and community spirit. Participants can feel safe knowing that all runners are insured against accidents. The event features a range of distances and a friendly atmosphere that helps build lasting connections among participants.
course_highlights: Start at Cathedral Square in Vilnius Old Town
Half-marathon distance: 21.098 km
Children’s and youth races for different age groups
additional: Participants who register by April 4 receive personalized bibs. Event T-shirts are available for an additional fee. The event includes children’s races starting from age 2, a 4.2 km youth race, and 5 km and 10 km distances with no age limits. Participants receive race packs with a timing chip. The event program includes warm-ups and awards for each distance. Runners of various age groups take part, with several start times and additional activities in Vilnius and the Old Town.

name: Atviros „Trakų Dainiaus bėgimo taurės“ 1000 m rungties varžybos
location: Trakų stadionas, Trakai, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The open 1000 m event of the “Trakai Dainius Running Cup” is an official 1000-meter race held at Trakai Stadium. The event is for both young athletes and recreational runners who want to test their speed and experience a true sporting atmosphere. The competition takes place in a professionally prepared setting, with a clearly marked stadium track. It is a great opportunity to challenge yourself in a classic running event and enjoy the spirit of sport in Trakai.
course_highlights: 1000-meter distance on the stadium athletics track
Professionally prepared stadium course
The competition takes place at Trakai Stadium, Birutės St. 44
additional: Registration is available by email at drasutisbarkauskas@gmail.com. The event takes place at Trakai Stadium, Birutės St. 44. This is an official 1000 m event for both young athletes and recreational runners. The event is included in the endurance sports calendar, and participants can compete and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in Trakai.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. Kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti
organizer: Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centras
description: The running competition for the prizes of Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre invites participants to register and compete. The event is held in Kupiškis to promote sporting activity and community spirit. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities and enjoy running in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The event is open to all age groups
Compete for prizes from Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre
Location: Kupiškis, Lithuania
additional: The event will take place on May 29, 2027. Registration is available online and via social media.

name: Bėgam už Marijampolę - 2026
description: Bėgam už Marijampolę is a traditional annual running event held in Marijampolė, bringing together participants of all ages. It is not only a competition but also an outdoor gathering for local residents that encourages an active lifestyle and a sense of community. The event features an updated running course where participants can test their endurance in a beautiful Lithuanian city. It also includes the “Einam už Marijampolę” walking tour, with 8 km and 14 km distances and free registration.
course_highlights: Updated running course in Marijampolė
Walking tour with 8 km and 14 km distances
Outdoor event that encourages a sense of community
additional: The “Einam už Marijampolę” walking tour takes place alongside the running event, and registration for the tour is free. The event brings together more than 1,000 participants, from the youngest to the oldest. Organized by the Marijampolė Athletics Sports Club. Event date: May 30, 2027; participant numbers and race distances are not specified.

name: Bėgimas „Kutaliai – Kaltinėnai“
description: The “Kutaliai–Kaltinėnai” Run is a traditional cross-country race held to commemorate the 141st anniversary of the birth of Aleksandras Stulginskis, President of the Republic of Lithuania, and Constituent Assembly Day. The competition takes place in hilly terrain, promoting physical activity and respect for sport. The start is in Kutaliai village, and the finish is at the stadium of Aleksandras Stulginskis Gymnasium in Kaltinėnai, Šilalė District. The event is intended for school athletes from cities and districts, as well as anyone else who meets the health requirements.
course_highlights: Start in Kutaliai village; finish at Kaltinėnai Gymnasium stadium
Cross-country race over hilly terrain
Held in memory of Aleksandras Stulginskis, President of the Republic of Lithuania
additional: Registration is open until 9:30 a.m. on race day at Aleksandras Stulginskis Gymnasium in Kaltinėnai. Participants must provide a doctor’s certificate or an entry form with a doctor’s approval. All participants receive commemorative medals, and the group winners receive medals for first, second, and third place. Athletes of various ages take part in the event; registration and health checks are required, and winners and participants are awarded.

name: „Vilties bėgimas“
location: Klaipėdos senamiestis ir Tiltų g. 26, Klaipėda, Lithuania
description: The Run of Hope is a civic initiative dedicated to fostering a culture of solidarity and hope in support of people with cancer and their loved ones. The event takes place in Klaipėda Old Town and offers distances ranging from 0.2 km for children to the full marathon of 42.195 km. The race follows looped courses, allowing participants to enjoy city views while contributing to an important social mission. This traditional event brings athletes and the community together for a shared goal.
course_highlights: Looped courses in Klaipėda Old Town
Marathon: 8 laps; half marathon: 4 laps
Distances for everyone, from children’s races to the marathon
additional: Participant registration takes place online until May 29 at 9 p.m. Early registration and race-pack pickup are available in Klaipėda from May 28–30. The event includes special courses for children, seniors, people with disabilities, and their supporters. The start and finish are at Tiltų g. 26, Klaipėda. The event will take place on June 5, 2027, in Klaipėda; the start location is the Church of St. Francis of Assisi in Klaipėda. Participants can register online and on site, and the event also includes other activities related to health and social well-being.

name: „Vilnius 5 in 5“ (1 diena)
organizer: VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir VšĮ “100 marathon club Lithuania”
description: “Vilnius 5 in 5” is a unique five-day running challenge in Vilnius, where participants can complete five marathons, half marathons, 12.6 km or 4.2 km distances on consecutive days. The event encourages endurance, determination and returning to the course each day, offering the chance to experience a true stage-running adventure. It is the first event of its kind in Lithuania, inspired by a global tradition, and takes place at the Vingis Park bandstand. Participants can choose their distance and start time. The event is organized by VšĮ “Maratomanija” and VšĮ “100 marathon club Lithuania”.
course_highlights: Vingis Park bandstand in Vilnius
Option to choose a 9:00 or 15:00 start time on the first three days for the 4.2 km and 12.6 km distances
Five starts over five days, with different distances: marathon, half marathon, 12.6 km and 4.2 km
additional: Time limits: 8 hours for the marathon, 4 hours for the half marathon, 3 hours for 12.6 km and 1 hour for 4.2 km. The course GPX file is available online. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Parents, guardians or coaches are responsible for minors. There will be a refreshment station on the course during the event. Participants agree that their photos and video footage may be used for marketing purposes. A multi-day run on courses in Vilnius’s Vingis Park, with various distances; registration and a health check are required.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with about 70 meters of elevation gain
Course runs through the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single- and double-track trails and gravel; the same loop is run day and night
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. A minimum of 7 loops (46.9 km) is required to earn a medal. Runners receive warnings 3, 2, and 1 minute before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. There are no showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents, but are not the organizer's responsibility. The event has a tent base and aid stations, but there are restrictions on support along the course.

name: Vilnius 5000 2027
location: Vilnius Vingio parko stadionas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Vilnius 5000 is a unique 5,000-metre race held at Vilnius Vingis Park Stadium. Participants have the opportunity to compete alongside the fastest runners from Lithuania and abroad, enjoy live DJ music and a festive atmosphere. The event offers various races, including individual 5,000 m runs, a 5x1000 m relay and a 2x400 m father-and-child relay. It is a great opportunity to improve your personal best and experience unforgettable support and community spirit.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Vilnius Vingis Park Athletics Stadium
5,000 m run, 5x1000 m mixed relay and 2x400 m father-and-child relay
Live DJ music and a festive atmosphere, with a food truck after the finish
additional: Participants are grouped according to their personal bests or predicted finish times. Elite-group participants must wear World Athletics-approved track running shoes and have a certificate of completion for an anti-doping course. The 5x1000 m relay teams are mixed, and there are no age restrictions for the 2x400 m father-and-child relay. A food truck will be available during the event, and participants agree that their results and photo/video material may be published publicly. The event takes place at Vilnius Vingis Stadium, participant registration takes place on the day of the event, and both professional and amateur runners may take part.

name: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai
description: The Olympic Day running events in Kaunas invite city residents and visitors to take part in a range of free sports activities. The event offers several running distances: a 500-metre children’s run, a 1,988-metre Lithuanian Olympic Mile, and 5- and 10-kilometre races. In addition to running, participants can try an extreme obstacle run, orienteering, and a 3×3 basketball tournament. The event aims to bring communities together and promote an active lifestyle, while also offering the chance to meet professional athletes and Olympians.
course_highlights: 500-metre children’s run
1,988-metre Lithuanian Olympic Mile
5- and 10-kilometre races
additional: More than 15,000 prizes will be handed out to participants. Visitors can also take part in educational and Olympic education events and games, and meet Olympians. The event is free and focused on mass participation and bringing communities together. More than 100 activities, runs, tournaments, educational events, a concert, and a film screening.

name: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga 2026
description: The Father’s Day run in Tauragė is a festive event inviting all running enthusiasts to take part with family and friends. It is a great opportunity to celebrate Father’s Day actively and have fun as part of the city festival. The event takes place during Tauragė City Festival, offering a chance to experience community spirit and sporting enthusiasm.
course_highlights: A festive run during Tauragė City Festival
A friendly atmosphere for families and friends
A chance to celebrate Father’s Day actively
additional: The event is part of Tauragė City Festival, takes place outdoors, and encourages active leisure and family participation.

name: 5000 m bėgimo varžybos „Vilnius 5000“.
description: Vilnius 5000 is a unique 5,000-meter running event held at the athletics stadium in Vilnius’s Vingis Park. The event offers not only individual 5,000 m races, but also relay races—a mixed 5x1000 m relay and a 2x400 m parent-and-child relay. Participants can enjoy live DJ music, a festive atmosphere, and support to help them achieve their best results. The competition is open to both professionals and recreational runners, and the organizers aim to promote athletics in Lithuania and encourage a sporting community.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at the athletics stadium in Vilnius’s Vingis Park
5,000 m race, 5x1000 m mixed relay, and 2x400 m parent-and-child relay
Live DJ music and a festive atmosphere, with a food truck after the finish
additional: Participants are divided into groups according to their personal bests or predicted finish times. Elite-group participants must wear running shoes approved by World Athletics for track use and have a certificate of completion for an anti-doping course. The 5x1000 m relay teams are mixed, and there are no age restrictions for the 2x400 m parent-and-child relay. A food truck awaits participants after the finish. The winners and runners-up are awarded sponsor prizes and cash prizes for outstanding results. The competition will take place on June 13, 2027, with various categories on offer, including elite and recreational runners, and detailed schedule information. The event promotes sport and family participation.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“
organizer: Krakių bendruomenės centras, Krakių kultūros centras, Krakių seniūnija
description: The “Krakės - Laiko ratu” running event is a traditional national race held in the town of Krakės, Kėdainiai District. The race welcomes everyone, from professionals to beginners and recreational runners, with a range of distances for different age groups. The start and finish are in the town centre, at Laisvės Square. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and awards in various age categories. Participants are served traditional šiupinys, and wooden outdoor games by “LPA GAMES” are available during the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Laisvės Square in the town of Krakės
Different distances for age groups: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 600 m “Pagauk gandrą” race on the Krakių garbės ratas for children and families
additional: Race numbers are issued from 11:00. The opening ceremony and the 600 m “Pagauk gandrą” race begin at 11:30. All participants are served šiupinys prepared by the Krakės Community Centre. Wooden outdoor games by “LPA GAMES” are available during the event. Awards are given to age-group winners, the youngest and oldest participants, and the fastest 10 km runners. Advance registration is online, and the entry fee is paid by bank transfer. Various distances and age groups are available, with games and activities also taking place during the event.

name: Alytaus maratonas 2026
location: Didžiosios Dailidės ežero apylinkės, Alytus, Alytaus rajonas, Lithuania
description: Alytus Marathon 2026 will take place on June 14, 2026, in Alytus, around Great Dailidė Lake. The event aims to promote running in Lithuania and raise Alytus’s profile, inviting both recreational and professional runners to compete in various distances, from a 500 m children’s race to a full marathon. Participants can choose from several running and Nordic walking distances. The courses are technically prepared for competition and use electronic timing. The event is organized by VšĮ „Maratomanija“ and ensures safe and fair competition for all participants.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 500 m children’s race to the 42.195 km marathon
Start and finish by Great Dailidė Lake in Alytus
Electronic timing with a chip attached to the front of the race shirt
additional: Participants are prohibited from using vehicles on the course. Timing is done with an electronic chip, which must be attached to the front of the race shirt. Time limits: marathon—6 hours; half marathon—3 hours; 10.6 km—2 hours; 5.3 km—1 hour; 2 km—0.5 hours; Nordic walking distances—5 hours. Start times for different distances: 12:00 for most races, 16:30 for the 2 km race, and 16:45 for the 500 m children’s race. During PINK RUN, both men and women can show their support and love for the women closest to them: their mother, daughter, sister, wife or best friend.

description: Molėtai Sports Center together with the Lithuanian Amateur Running Association invites you to the traditional “Molėtai Runs 2024” race, held for the fourth time, on October 20, 2024. The race distances include 3 km (girls/boys, born in 2006 or later), 9 km (women/men, ages 19–44 and 45 and over), and a 400 m course with no age restrictions. The event brings together running enthusiasts and offers the opportunity to participate in various age groups.

description: The „Rimi“ Vilnius Marathon, taking place on September 8, 2024, will start for the 22nd time in Vilnius, at Cathedral Square. It is Lithuania’s largest running event, attracting professional runners and enthusiasts from across the country and abroad. Participants can choose from a range of distances: 42 km, 21 km 98 m, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, and a 200 m children’s race.

name: Bėgimas "Ateik ir Įveik!"
description: The “Come and Conquer” run is an unforgettable event full of challenges and surprises. The most enduring runners are invited to set off on an adventure through the hills and valleys of Ąžuolynas Park! From a true test of endurance to active entertainment, there’s something for everyone among the different race distances and obstacle courses—whether you’re a thrill-seeker or an enthusiast of active recreation. This year, the run attracted a record number of participants and was held at the KTU Student Campus and in Ąžuolynas Park.

name: Šiaulių Bėgimas
description: The renewed and unique representative Šiauliai Run 2024 will take place on September 22 at 12:00. THE BIG START. The project’s main goal is to promote physical activity and sport by encouraging an active, fulfilling way to spend leisure time, fostering community spirit and a healthy lifestyle. The run will follow the city’s central streets, passing places significant to Šiauliai’s history. It is for people of all ages, from recreational runners to professionals. The program includes a 700 m children’s run, a 1236 m run commemorating the date of the Battle of the Sun, and 5 km and 10 km runs.

name: Nidos pusės maratonas
description: The 24th International Nida Half Marathon will take place on September 28, 2024, in Nida. It is organized by the public institution Kuršių Legendos together with Neringa City Municipality and other institutions. Participants can compete in various distances: the Nida Half Marathon (21.098 km), the 5 km YIT Run, and children’s races of 2 km, 0.5 km, and 0.21 km. Registration will take place only when race numbers are issued, and the starting line will be near Sakutis café.

name: Swampman Backyard Ultra
description: Swampman Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon in which participants must run a distance of 6,706 meters (4.167 miles) in less than one hour. After each lap, the remaining time can be used for rest and food. Every hour, you will return to the starting line and run another lap until only one runner remains. The Lithuanian record is 22 laps, and the world record is 108 laps.

name: PINK RUN su Antėja
description: PINK RUN with Antėja is an annual pink ribbon charity run dedicated to the fight against breast cancer and the prevention of this disease. Join our event in the heart of Kaunas—Laisvės Avenue—and run for the women you love. Support the fight against breast cancer by taking part in runs of various distances for both professionals and amateurs. Pink Run with Antėja is more than a run; it is a message that we love them.
